text:
alex: Odd bug when running AsyncClient in our FastAPI app — occasional "There is no current event loop" and long pauses.

alex: We instantiate AsyncClient at import and use it as a dependency. After a few token refresh retries the worker stalls for ~2-5s.

maria: Looks familiar: auth refresh can fall back to a sync path on certain httpx errors. That path uses requests + time.sleep for backoff which blocks the event loop.

sam: Also saw helper utils that call asyncio.run() so tests with pytest-asyncio blow up with nested event loop errors.

jules: Action items: (1) audit refresh to be fully async and replace time.sleep with asyncio.sleep/anyio.sleep, (2) remove hidden asyncio.run usage and expose explicit sync/async helpers, (3) add typing overloads so AsyncClient is distinct from sync client, (4) add uvicorn+pytest-asyncio e2e test.

maria: Short-term workaround: create client on startup and run refresh proactively; or set REDWOOD_DISABLE_SYNC_FALLBACK=1 in server env.

ci-bot: Created RED-4123 and attached logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-4123

alex: I'll upload a tiny repro and CI trace to the ticket. Thanks all.
